label: Three headless shapes: -z oneshot, chat -q non-TTY oneshot, chat -Q quiet
summary: hermes -z prints only final response text (no session id line); chat -q on non-TTY implies --oneshot; chat -Q suppresses banner/spinner and prints response + session info

label: --query-file is injection-safe
summary: Reads query from file or stdin (-), nothing shell-interpreted, mutually exclusive with -q

label: -Q stdout machine-readable, session id on stderr
summary: Response to stdout; session_id: line to stderr; backend errors as Error: on stderr

label: Exit codes: -z 0/1/2; chat -Q 0/1/130
summary: -z: 0 success, 1 agent failure/no response, 2 usage error or failed/partial with empty response; chat -Q: 0 success, 1 failed, 130 interrupt

label: Isolation flags: --ignore-user-config/--ignore-rules/--safe-mode
summary: Skip config (credentials still load), skip rules/memory/preloaded skills, disable plugins+MCP; none isolate the sessions DB

label: Comparison table vs six runtimes complete
